cross_relation.note: a relation responding to a fault it has no physical business seeing is a false-positive source; a fault with no responder is a coverage gap. Neither is visible when each relation is tested only against its own fault.

controls.basis: 2.5 A of extra draw on one motor of four against a 0.05 A per-branch measurement sigma is a 50-sigma asymmetry; arithmetic, not a property of this tool
controls.control: a large mechanical fault moves its own relation far past the clean spread

controls.basis: catalog.py declares effort_drift gated on a stationary operating point and source_impedance on current variation; a sinusoidal setpoint and a constant load violate them by construction
controls.control: a relation outside its declared gate returns exactly zero

instrument_controls.does_not_establish: that the instrument's other measurements are correct. A control pair shows it still responds to a known stimulus and stays silent on a null one -- it is a liveness and discrimination check, not a calibration.

predictions.reading: a violated blindness prediction is a FALSIFICATION of something written down before the simulator existed, and the catalogue is wrong rather than the test

results.why_predicted: the controller compensates, so the plant output carries no error even while the plant degrades
the branch currents still sum to the pack current; a collective efficiency loss raises both sides together
a cooling fault changes no current anywhere
a pack fault is common-mode across a symmetric actuator group
a scheduling fault has no thermal signature in the ESCs
a mechanical fault does not stretch the control period

violations.why_predicted: the controller compensates, so the plant output carries no error even while the plant degrades

relations_without_one.odometry_inertial: needs an odometry channel this simulator does not produce
relations_without_one.wheel_consistency: ground vehicles only; this simulator models a rotor platform with no wheels or steering

what_this_is_not: A simulator written by the same author as the residuals, in the same week. A relation passing here is consistent with a model of the physics, not with any vehicle. Every floor is a floor against SIMULATED noise, and the phenomena this simulator cannot produce are exactly the ones it cannot warn about.
zero_clean_note: For these, 'exceeds the clean maximum' degenerates to 'is not zero' and the ratio is undefined. A detection against a zero baseline is a weaker statement than one against a measured noise floor and is flagged per row.
